style.name: 晨雾便签
style.css: #root{--ink:#313a43;--muted:#6b7881;--accent:#bf694e;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;padding:17px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #ffffffa8;background:#f3f0e8dc;backdrop-filter:blur(18px);color:var(--ink);font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:inset 0 1px #ffffff35,0 12px 28px #0002}#root:before{content:'';pointer-events:none;position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(125deg,#ffffff15,transparent 58%)}header,footer{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;position:relative;flex:none;gap:6px;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}header .mark{color:var(--accent);font-size:20px;line-height:1}header span:nth-child(2){margin-right:auto}header .count{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.hero{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;min-width:0;flex:none;margin:12px 0 5px}.number{color:var(--accent);font-size:58px;font-weight:650;line-height:1;letter-spacing:0;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.hero-text{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}.headline{font-size:16px;font-weight:650;line-height:1.25;overflow:hidden;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;-webkit-line-clamp:2}.subtitle{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis}.task-list{min-height:0;position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;overflow:hidden;flex:1}.task{display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;min-width:0;font-size:12px;line-height:1.4}.check{border:1px solid var(--accent);height:15px;width:15px;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;border-radius:4px;color:var(--accent);font-size:10px;line-height:1}.task.done{opacity:.55}.task.done .task-text{text-decoration:line-through}.task-text{min-width:0;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis}footer{border-top:1px solid #ffffffa8;padding-top:7px;margin-top:auto;font-size:9px}.footer-mark{color:var(--accent)}.hero{margin:12px 0 4px}.task-list{gap:9px}.task{border-bottom:1px solid #ffffffa8;padding-bottom:5px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.mark{animation:glow 3s ease-in-out infinite alternate}@keyframes glow{to{opacity:.45;transform:rotate(35deg)}}}
